# Test complex PE workflows - end-to-end scenarios

# Research paper summarization workflow
pe run research-prompt.txt --var Paper=paper.pdf |
  pe extract --tag summary |
  pe optimize --method textgrad --objective "clarity and conciseness" |
  pe test --inline criteria.yaml |
  pe build --output final-summary.txt
stdout 'Workflow complete'
exists final-summary.txt
contains final-summary.txt 'Key findings:'

# Multi-model consensus workflow  
pe run prompt.txt --provider openai --output gpt4.txt &
pe run prompt.txt --provider anthropic --output claude.txt &
pe run prompt.txt --provider google --output gemini.txt &
wait
pe fusion gpt4.txt claude.txt gemini.txt --consensus weighted
stdout 'Consensus reached'
stdout 'Agreement score: 0.89'

# A/B testing workflow
pe init --experiment ab-test
pe branch create variant-a
pe optimize prompt.txt --method pe2 --target "engagement"
pe commit -m "Variant A: Optimized for engagement"
pe checkout main
pe branch create variant-b  
pe optimize prompt.txt --method evolve --target "accuracy"
pe commit -m "Variant B: Optimized for accuracy"
pe ab-test variant-a variant-b --duration 1h --metrics engagement,accuracy
stdout 'A/B Test Results:'
stdout 'Variant A: engagement=0.87, accuracy=0.82'
stdout 'Variant B: engagement=0.79, accuracy=0.91'
stdout 'Winner: Variant B (higher combined score)'

# Component library workflow
pe mod init mycompany/prompts
pe compose --import https://github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless
pe compose --import https://github.com/openai/best-practices
pe compose context.txt instruction.txt --style cot --optimize
pe test component-tests.yaml
pe build --bundle
pe mod publish
stdout 'Published: mycompany/prompts v1.0.0'

# Production deployment workflow
pe build config.yaml --validate --minify
stdout '✓ Validation passed'
pe test regression-tests.yaml --baseline prod-baseline.json
stdout '✓ No regression detected'
pe security scan
stdout '✓ Security scan passed'
pe build --production --sign
stdout '✓ Built and signed'
exists prompt.prod.signed

# Continuous optimization workflow
pe optimize prompt.txt --method hybrid --auto
stdout 'Starting continuous optimization'
stdout 'Iteration 1: Best method: textgrad'
stdout 'Iteration 2: Best method: semantic'
stdout 'Iteration 3: Best method: evolve'
stdout 'Convergence achieved'
stdout 'Final improvement: +34%'

# Debug workflow
pe run failing-prompt.txt --debug
stderr 'Error: Ambiguous instruction'
pe analyze failing-prompt.txt --diagnose
stdout 'Issues found:'
stdout '  1. Conflicting directives'
stdout '  2. Missing context'
pe fix failing-prompt.txt --auto
stdout 'Applied 2 fixes'
pe run failing-prompt-fixed.txt
stdout 'Success'

# Batch processing workflow
ls prompts/*.txt | pe map "pe optimize {} --output optimized/{}"
stdout 'Processed 10 prompts'
pe metrics --batch --inputs prompts/*.txt --baseline optimized/*.txt
stdout 'Average improvement: 23%'

# Knowledge distillation workflow
pe run teacher-prompt.txt --provider gpt-4 --examples 100 > examples.jsonl
pe train student-prompt.txt --data examples.jsonl --method distillation
stdout 'Training student prompt'
stdout 'Epoch 1/5: Loss=0.34'
stdout 'Epoch 5/5: Loss=0.12'
pe compare teacher-prompt.txt student-prompt.txt
stdout 'Performance retention: 94%'
stdout 'Cost reduction: 78%'

-- research-prompt.txt --
Summarize the key findings of the paper: {{.Paper}}

-- paper.pdf --
[Binary PDF content]

-- criteria.yaml --
tests:
  - assert:
      - length_range: [200, 500]
      - contains: "findings"
      - readability_score: [0.8, 1.0]

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze this data and provide insights.

-- component-tests.yaml --
tests:
  - component: context.txt
    assert:
      - valid: true
      - compatible_with: [instruction.txt]

-- config.yaml --
prompt: Production-ready prompt
provider: openai
model: gpt-4
temperature: 0.7

-- regression-tests.yaml --
tests:
  - input: "Test case 1"
    max_latency_ms: 200
    min_score: 0.85

-- prod-baseline.json --
{
  "latency_p95": 180,
  "accuracy": 0.87
}

-- failing-prompt.txt --
Be concise but explain everything in detail.
Focus on accuracy while being creative.

-- teacher-prompt.txt --
You are an expert AI assistant with deep knowledge across domains.

-- student-prompt.txt --
You are a helpful assistant.
